svg.title: Atlas architecture layers
svg.desc: Four layers. Presentation (app/api · web/): FastAPI routers and the React app. Every route returns a typed Pydantic DTO, never an ORM model. Depends on Application. Application (app/application): Use cases that orchestrate the domain: sync, metrics, forecasts and advice. Depends only on Domain ports. Domain (app/domain): Entities and repository ports (Protocols). The model of delivery, free of any framework. Zero framework imports. Standard library only. Infrastructure (app/infrastructure): SQLAlchemy adapters, the database session, connectors, the AI adapter and SPA serving. Implements the Domain ports. Presentation depends on Application, Application on Domain, and Infrastructure implements Domain: dependencies point inward, enforced by tests/test_architecture.py.
